title: Kid Ory and King Oliver not heard
summary: Moore says he heard nothing of Kid Ory in those years; everything was Armstrong.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Remembering King Oliver: the man, the band, the decline

blocks.x: Do you recall hearing Kid Ory on any recordings or broadcast, either when you were in Chicago or when you went to California?

No, I didn't hear anything about Kid Ory. Everything was Armstrong, Armstrong. And then at one time, I heard of King Oliver, and also. But I didn't a, I didn't get the chance to. I think Ory was in a, in California. He always -- when he left New Orleans, I think he went straight
to a, to a, California. He lived in Los Angeles. But I had, hadn't been to California at that, at that time, you know.
